test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following characteristics is INCORRECT about the tropical evergreen forests of India?

options.text: In these forests, trees reach great heights of up to 60 m or above.
They are found in warm and humid areas.
These forests receive annual precipitation of below 150 cm.

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**These forests receive annual precipitation of below 150 cm.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical evergreen forests**

 
 
• Tropical evergreen forests are found in regions where the annual rainfall is more than 200cm.
 
• The forests thrive well at a monthly mean temperature of 18 degrees Celsius or higher in the coldest months.
 
• Tropical Evergreen forests are dense, and multi-layered and harbor many types of plants and animals.
 
• Due to the dense growth of trees, in the tropical evergreen forests the sunlight cannot reach the ground. This type of forest is rich in numerous species of trees which reach great heights of up to 60 m or above.
 
• Some important trees of the tropical evergreen forest are Ebony and mahogany. Rosewood, Rubber, and Cinchona. Bamboo, Sandalwood, Khair, Kusum, and Mulberry are commercially important species.
 
• These are found on the Eastern and Western slopes of the Western Ghats and in warm and humid areas. ​​​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical Evergreen Forests** are found in parts of the Western Ghats, This can be in Kerala. However western Ghats region is present in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
 
• Kerala region is not fully covered by the Tropical Evergreen forest as Lakshadweep is covered fully with Tropical Evergreen Forest
